description: GLM-5.3-Flash (glm5_next) serving constraints for the PR #53906 vLLM build (pinned at 933876c). The PR wires quant_config into exactly three module families: routed experts (FusedMoEFactory, models/glm5next/nvidia/model.py:225,:233), shared experts, and the dense-layer MLP projections. Every other text-model Linear is constructed with quant_config=None (MLA projections at model.py:329 inside Glm5NextMLAAttention; KDA/linear_attn projections and conv1d; hyper-connection mixers; the router has no quantizable parameter at all) - quantized bytes for those families have no executed route in the pinned runtime.

format_rules.detail: PR #53906@933876c passes quant_config only to routed experts (model.py:225,:233), shared experts, and dense MLP projections. All other text Linears get quant_config=None (MLA q_a/q_b/kv_a/o_proj at model.py:329; KDA in_proj/out_proj/in_proj_ba/conv1d; hyper-connection mixers; mlp.gate router has no quant parameter), so a quantized rung on any of them has no executed route on the declared target. BF16 and FP8_SOURCE passthroughs stay legal: the pinned units ship verbatim at source precision (body FP8 block-[128,128] + scale_inv, which the PR loads natively; kv_b and KDA o_proj are BF16 source). This mirrors the model profile's pins - defense in depth per principle 9, judged against the pinned runtime, not against taste. Re-derive this rule if the PR revision changes; the pin lives in the artifact's serving-lane provenance.
